name: GraphQL
description: Code intelligence for GraphQL schema and operation files.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information and go to definitions in GraphQL files. The language server starts when a GraphQL file opens in a project and stops when none are open. These features need a GraphQL configuration in the project, such as .graphqlrc.
